title: Title identity
description: One declaration of who made the title and what it is called. Every platform's packaging and every platform's writable-storage location are built from it, so the identity a console shows and the identity a save is filed under cannot disagree.

developer.description: Author or studio. Names a directory on platforms that file saves under the developer, so it excludes the characters a path cannot carry.

name.description: Display name, and a directory name on the same platforms.

version.description: ##.## - one console rejects anything else, so the stricter rule is the shared one.

ids.description: Per-platform identifiers. A platform that files saves under an identifier rather than a name needs one; a platform that does not is absent here.

vita.description: Nine characters: four author characters then five digits. Also names the writable data directory.

psp.description: Names the memory-card directory the title is installed into, and the writable location inside it.
